title: Add sumQualityInDesign Function Across All Languages And UIs
description: Add a new function sumQualityInDesign(kit, designId, qualityId) and add a test Design/Quality/Sum where you use Nakagin Capsule Tower and sum up the effective floor area. Implement it for every programming language (Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript, C#) and UI (sketchpad, grasshopper).
summary: Implemented sumQualityInDesign function across all programming languages and UIs. The function sums the values of a quality across all pieces in a design, checking piece-level props first then falling back to type-level props. Added Design/Quality/Sum test using Nakagin Capsule Tower and the effective floor area quality (expected sum: 2349.53). All tests pass.
